dog.description_text:
We've had Zuessey for about 2 months and he has been a great foster dog. He was able to acclimate to his new home immediately. He is a very friendly dog when meeting new people and dogs. On the leash he will sometime tug but is easily redirectable, loves to chew on things so it is important to be monitoring him when going on walks to see what he puts in his mouth. Other than that, he requires a lot of love and attention as he will follow you everywhere and want to cuddle and sleep with you while on the couch or on the bed.

﻿Zuessey is approximately 7y 4m 29d old and is fully grown at 74 pounds. They are microchipped and up to date on all age-appropriate medical care. Their breed is unknown as we have not had a DNA test done.

Although our dogs are listed as unknown breed, buildings with specific dog restrictions typically enforce their rules based on what breeds a dog appears to resemble. It's always important to keep that in mind and know your building's policies before adopting a dog.

This dog is available for adoption through Muddy Paws Rescue. If you're interested in adopting, the first thing you should do is begin the registration process at www.muddypawsrescue.org. If you are already a registered adopter with Muddy Paws Rescue, please email us at adoptionmeetings@muddypawsrescue.org.
